name: LinkedIn Marketing API
description: LinkedIn's Marketing and Advertising REST API. Provides access to ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, analytics, audience segments, conversions, and organizational content management. Requires OAuth 2.0 authentication with appropriate marketing scopes and an approved LinkedIn Marketing Developer application.
